text: 1.7 It's often said that it's cruel to use animals for entertainment. However, I would like to argue against this idea. I know that many animal lovers would disagree with me, but let me explain my point of view. First of all, keeping animals in zoos helps protect them. For example, many species, such as the giant panda and the snow leopard, are endangered in the wild, so they are safer in zoos. Another point is that zoos have an important educational role. For instance, children can see animals up close. When I was a child, my father took me to the zoo. I learned about exotic animals, and I also learned to care about animals. Modern zoos have improved their conditions. Animals are no longer kept in small cages, and zoos have large areas where animals can feel as if they are in their natural habitat. To summarise, zoos help protect animals and educate us. In short, modern zoos are comfortable, safe places for wild animals. In conclusion, I believe that we should help zoos by visiting them and donating money.
